title: Lit Locals prospect (preview factory)
description: Input card for the Lit Locals preview factory. Omit reviews, listing URLs, and photo_url when unknown. Never invent reviews.

slug.description: Folder name under out/. Letters, numbers, hyphens.

google_url.description: Public Google listing URL. Skip or empty if none.

yelp_url.description: Public Yelp listing URL. Skip or empty if none.

reviews.description: Only real quotes from the prospect JSON. Omit the field if unknown. Factory never invents these.

photo_url.description: http(s) listing photo. Empty or omit to use the trade-pack Unsplash, then packs/heroes/.

stripe_url.description: Optional. Buy button href. Defaults to #buy.
